svg.title: WHAT THE NEURON MODEL RECORDED
svg.desc: Every square is one published input setting. Basal input varies horizontally and tuft input vertically. The symbols show three spike-count classes. The new bit depends only on the two input settings.

g.text: 1 when the basal setting exceeds the tuft setting.
0 when it is smaller or equal.
Some pairs of ranges contain both bit values.
Shai et al. (2015), ModelDB 180373 · control simulation · each nominal input setting receives weight 1/651
